The Books section has two kinds of material. The first group contains the two main textbook entry points currently rendered on the site. The second group contains the working book-series volumes that share the same navigation sidebar.

Use the Books and Textbooks sidebar to move between these pages. Individual chapter pages are indexed in [Article Index](../resources/articles.html).

## Core Textbooks

::: {.resource-grid}
::: {.resource-card}
### The Physics of Golf

Golf-specific textbook chapters on mechanics, control-affine modeling, multibody dynamics, shaft behavior, impact, and motor control.

[Open The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html){.resource-link}
:::
::: {.resource-card}
### The Geometry of Motion

Mathematical and computational foundations for rigid-body dynamics, nonlinear control, biomechanics, neural control, and simulation.

[Open The Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html){.resource-link}
:::
:::

### Volume I: Tangent-Space Methods for Nonlinear Control

Foundations of tangent-space exactness, contraction, local optimal control, and counterfactual decomposition.

[Open Volume I Main Page](tangent-space-methods.html){.resource-link}

::: {.resource-card}
### Volume II: Control Is Motion

Trajectory-centric nonlinear control and the geometric mechanics framing for high-dimensional motion.

[Open Volume II Main Page](control-is-motion.html){.resource-link}
[Source manuscript available (LaTeX/Colab); web chapters forthcoming](control-is-motion.html#book2-ch1){.resource-link}
